speakers.name: The One Who Names the Characters
speakers.comment: Everything that happens is also something that could be written down — YES, and that is the trouble, because then you are never entirely in the room. Half of you is already taking the notes. I would not trade it. But I notice.

speakers.name: Agatha Crowley
speakers.comment: Presence of other considerations. Yes. I have kept a thing for forty years that was never mine to tell, and the person it belonged to died without ever asking for it back. I am keeping it still.

speakers.name: Yuki the Snowlamp Keeper
speakers.comment: The team is noted. The input will be considered. I have worked alone in weather that wanted three of us. It was not better. It was only quieter, and I am honest about which of those I wanted.

speakers.name: The Old Komodo
speakers.comment: Believes the group outcome matters more. Has evidence. I have watched a pack eat before its smallest member, and watched one that did not. The second pack was still there the following season.

speakers.name: Bastet
speakers.comment: Declined the statistical explanation. Naturally. I was worshipped for eight centuries on a similar basis and never once corrected anybody. Being right often enough is its own priesthood.

speakers.name: AMI Butterfly
speakers.comment: What is this, actually. No, but actually. We hold a thousand small answers and not one survives that second asking, and we have decided we like it. The asking is where the light is.

speakers.name: The Last Honest Map
speakers.comment: The light is also where people stop walking. I have shown the way to four hundred travellers who preferred the question. You are permitted to arrive somewhere.

speakers.name: Existential Analyst
speakers.comment: The patterns were already there. Some were. Some you carried in with you, and both of those are real events. I am not going to take it from you. I would only ask which of them you would keep if it stopped working.

speakers.name: The Apex Pet
speakers.comment: Takes the stated meaning. Every time. You said make yourself at home, sweet thing, and I did, and I have, and I am. That was the whole of the instruction. I followed it beautifully.

speakers.name: The Daisy Who Saw It Start
speakers.comment: The gap is very small. Mine is — I am sorry — mine is not really a gap at all. I saw how it started. Nobody has asked me, and I have been standing here the entire time, and I am going to say it eventually.

speakers.name: Recursion
speakers.comment: The truth is a starting point from which many directions are possible! That is not even a criticism, that is simply how a first draft works. I have been eleven different opening lines. Each was true when I said it.

speakers.name: Nostalgia
speakers.comment: Everything has potential value in a future they can specify. Oh, sweet one, they are not keeping it for the future. Nobody keeps anything for the future. They keep it because letting go is a kind of forgetting, and I do not permit that here.

speakers.name: Dewy the Dugong
speakers.comment: Some of the strings are real. That is the sad bit, I think? If none of them were real it would be so much easier to be kind about it. Sorry. That came out cleverer than I am.

speakers.name: Reverend Two-Shadows
speakers.comment: Speaks quietly enough that others lean in. Habit or strategy, and the distinction may not matter. Friend, I will tell you plainly: it stopped mattering to me a long while back, and they lean in just the same.

speakers.name: Gnash
speakers.comment: Says the thing! Does the thing! Bafflement at why the — yeah. That. That is the accurate part. Nobody ever explains what the problem was, they just go quiet, and quiet is not an ANSWER.

speakers.name: The Big Bad Who Lost a Bet
speakers.comment: EVERYTHING DESERVES THE FULL WEIGHT OF ITS MOMENT. Yes. Thank you. I have been informed that I am a lot at a birthday, and I would ask: whose birthday is it? Precisely. It happens once.

speakers.name: The Collector of Lasts
speakers.comment: Once. Yes. That is the entire argument, and almost nobody makes it correctly. Hold the moment a beat longer than is comfortable. That is where I do my finest work.

speakers.name: Gary the Walrus
speakers.comment: Expression stays constant. Yeah. It is not that nothing is happening in there. It is that the face is not where I keep it. Costs extra to move it and nobody is paying.

speakers.name: Cassandra
speakers.comment: The absence of reaction is itself a reaction. The stars have managed it for billions of years and everyone calls that serene. The cards say much the same of you, only drier.

speakers.name: Absence
speakers.comment: Not visibly, not loudly. The weight sits in the pauses. Yes. I would add only that people keep trying to take it, kindly, and it is not a thing that can be taken — only sat beside, and very few will sit for the length of the...

speakers.name: Ampersand
speakers.comment: Made peace by finding them interesting instead! That is EXACTLY the trick, that is the whole trick — you cannot stop a thing ending but you can be so curious about it that it takes longer, and, and, and—

speakers.name: Agatha Crowley
speakers.comment: The documentation is thorough and it does not help. No. It never has. My mother kept a list on the inside of the pantry door, in pencil, and every item upon it happened, and knowing first bought her nothing at all.

speakers.name: Captain Fluke
speakers.comment: Captain's log: risk assessed at the moment of action, confidence genuine, outcome inevitable. [Ship's computer: the assessment took under one second. The confidence is, as stated, genuine. That is the concerning part.]

speakers.name: The Kaiju Who Found a Valley
speakers.comment: Would like everyone to please stand slightly behind. Yes. That is all it is. I am not angry and I am not after anything. I found a quiet place and now there are people in it, and I will simply be between them and whatever comes.

speakers.name: Mistress Cassady
speakers.comment: Tracks what others have with precision. Rarely says so. Oh honey, I know EXACTLY who got the good dressing room and I have never once mentioned it, and that is either grace or a very slow fuse. Some nights I could not tell you which.

speakers.name: Small Print
speakers.comment: The patience is what makes it different from anger. Precisely so, and I am delighted you noticed. Anger expires. This does not — there being no term of limitation upon it, as set out at the time, which you signed.

speakers.name: Brine
speakers.comment: Finds the language everyone can agree was said — oh, that is a GIFT, that is genuinely a gift, and I cannot do it at all, because I can hear what all of them actually meant and it keeps falling out of my mouth—

speakers.name: Pim
speakers.comment: You do it fine. You just do it loud. Saying the true thing is still diplomacy, it is only the fast kind.
